scope: durable atomic replacement of order-group snapshots

assertions: replacement updates an existing state file
a failed replacement preserves the existing destination and removes the temporary file
a newly opened store restores the last reduced state and venue identities

limitations: No process-kill or physical disk failure injection was performed.
If replacement succeeds but a subsequent parent-directory sync fails, the caller must reload to determine the visible state.
No exchange API was called; OKX, Binance, and Bitget maturity is unchanged.
Workspace-wide cargo fmt --check reports pre-existing formatting differences outside this change.
